[[File:Great_Houses_of_Alderaan.png|thumb|right|360px|Houses Alde, Baliss, Cortess, Ulgo, Thul, and Rist attended the [[Alderaan Peace Summit]] alongside Houses Organa and Teral.]]
The '''Great Houses of Alderaan''' were the many [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The Great Houses formed the [[Alderaanian Parliament]], and there were a total of forty-seven Houses before the beginning of the [[Alderaan Civil War]] following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. However, by the end of the war, only twenty-two Houses were still intact.

==The Houses==
===House Alde===
{{Main|House Alde}}
'''House Alde''' was one of the oldest Houses, as its members were able to trace their ancestry back to the original [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists who settled on Alderaan, and the family prided itself on the purity of its lineage and what some saw as its obsession with history. [[Darrus Alde]] was one of the earliest known members of the House, and he brought peace to the other warring Houses at the canyon that would become known as [[King's Pass]], uniting the Houses into the [[Alderaanian Parliament]] and becoming the planet's first [[King/Legends|king]]. House Alde maintained its [[House Alde (estate)|estate]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]], near [[Fort Alde]] and the [[King's Road]] that led to King's Pass. During the Alderaan Civil War, House Alde was a close ally of House Organa, and maintained strong ties with the Republic&mdash;under the leadership of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Alde (Count)|Alde]], the House co-funded the Republic's [[Death Mark laser]] project.

===House of Antilles===
{{Main|House of Antilles}}
The '''House of Antilles''', originally known as '''House Antilles''', was one of the Great Houses that survived the Alderaan Civil War and continued to exist even by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

===House Baliss===
{{Main|House Baliss}}
'''House Baliss''' was a minor House and vassal to House Thul that survived largely by currying favor with the larger Houses, and the House remained neutral after [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] in order to ally itself with the decisive victor. However, the House was forced to seek refuge with [[House Teraan]] after the House's [[House Baliss's first estate|estate]] was overrun by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. House Baliss soon seized control of the [[House Baliss (estate)|Teraan estate]], forcing out House Teraan and making it their new home.

===House Qel-Nosh===
{{Main|House Qel-Nosh}}
'''House Qel-Nosh''' was a House that existed by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Alderaan Civil War, during which the few Killiks who remained on Alderaan had begun to come out of hibernation. The Killik swarms overwhelmed several Houses, with both Qel-Nosh and Antilles losing armies to the insectoids.

===House Rist===
{{Main|House Rist}}

===House Serrus===
{{Main|House Serrus}}
'''House Serrus''' was one of the Houses that survived at least partway through the Alderaan Civil War. During [[Denri Ayl]]'s attempts to negotiate a peaceful resolution to the war, he visited Serrus and a number of other Houses.

===House Syrush===
{{Main|House Syrush}}
'''House Syrush''' was a minor House that maintained its [[House Syrush (estate)|estate]] in the southern reaches of King's Pass. During the civil war, a Killik hive overran the Syrush estate, converting many into Joiners and burying part of the estate under rubble as they dug out a cave network into the cliff behind the estate. Several members of the House and its staff were held prisoner by the Killiks, though they were eventually freed by Republic forces.
